description: Upload a LOCAL audio/video file (up to 2 GB) to Memo AI for transcription. Returns the transcription UUID immediately with status "queued" — transcription runs asynchronously, so poll memo_get_transcription with that UUID every ~10s until status is "completed" (or "failed"/"insufficient_balance"). Requires an API key created with 'Allow file uploads'.

ai_metadata.description: Also generate the AI layer (summary, title, speaker names, reports). Default false — you usually analyse the transcript yourself.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the local audio/video file

language.description: Spoken language code (e.g. en, es, ru). Omit for auto-detection.

project_id.description: Attach to a project (UUID from memo_list_projects)

name: memo_upload_file
